listing.name: Edited Vanilla Portraits plus some extras
listing.summary: Adds semi-realistic, style-consistent portrait edits to vanilla characters and introduces new portraits with a natural extension of the original art style.

description:
Edited Vanilla Portraits

Semi-Realistic Portrait Overhaul & Additions

Overview

My portrait pack. I wanted something close to vanilla style. I'm also including some AI generated photos expanding the available character pool, but I'll eventually edit these manually to match the enhanced art style. For those who want to have the Additional Portraits show up in the Player Portrait, just modify the player faction file from the Edited Vanilla Portraits mod or add a player faction file to the Additional Portraits mod.

Features

• Edited vanilla portraits and illustrations(lighting, clarity, subtle refinements)

• Brand new semi-realistic portraits

• Style matched to vanilla tone and composition

• No gameplay changes — purely visual

Preview

Spoiler[close]SpoilerIllustrations

[close]

Download

Download - Edited Vanilla Portraits 1.01

Download - Additional Portraits 1.02

Other Mod Portraits

I also have an expanding collection of edited portraits from some of the mods I use since I wanted a bit of consistency with the portraits.

So far I've contacted

Ryxsen1421

for his

United Aurora Federation Mod

and gotten permission to post the edited portraits for that.

>>UAF Portraits Download Here<<

SpoilerNon-Anime UAF Preview

[close]

Here's my additional portraits for

Valkyrians

though I've yet to actually get a message to the original author. It's in a Chinese sub, and one needs to increase rank to be able to send a short message  :o. I'll remove these if asked to do so, but some of you guys might want additional portraits for that faction if you're using it.

>>Additional Valkyrian Portraits Download Here<<

SpoilerNon-Anime Valkyrians Preview

[close]

I'll upload the rest when I get permission.

Compatibility

• Tested on Starsector 0.98a

• Compatible with most mods

• May conflict with other portrait replacements

Notes

This is a visual enhancement mod intended to feel like a natural extension of vanilla. I'll be editing the ones that seems "off" to maintain consistency.

All portraits aim for consistency in:

• Lighting

• Proportions

• Art direction

Credits

• Vanilla assets — Fractal Softworks

• Original Mod Authors mentioned above

Changelog

v1.0.2

• Edited some portraits from the Additional Set to be more consistent (painted style portraits)

Changelog

v1.0.1

• Changed Mod Name

• Edited some portraits to be more consistent

• Added a set for additional Valkyrian portraits

v1.0

• Initial release

• Added new portraits

Feedback is welcome!
